observations: Photo 0 shows a black DSLR body with 'Canon' and 'EOS 600D' clearly printed on the front, plus a Canon EF-S 18-55mm lens, lens cap, and a 'Canon Digital' strap.
Photo 1 shows the same camera's rear/side with a flip-out LCD screen, Canon control buttons (MENU, INFO, SET, AF, WB), confirming Canon branding again.
Photo 2 shows two camera bodies on a shelf: one labeled 'Canon EOS 600D' and another labeled 'Canon EOS 700D', each with a lens, alongside what appears to be a Nikon lens cap in the background.
No Sony logo, Sony model text, or Sony-style body design appears anywhere in the three photos.
No visible shutter-count screen, no power-on test, no memory card, battery, or charger shown.
No visible cracks, scratches, or fungus in the lens glass from this angle, but the lens interior/aperture blades are not shown.

claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera very neat and sharp
claims.evidence: Photos show a Canon EOS 600D body consistent with the model name, but 'UK used' origin and 'sharp' image quality cannot be confirmed from static photos; no test shot or power-on shown.
Photo 0, photo 1, and photo 2 all show 'Canon' and 'EOS 600D' / 'EOS 700D' markings; no Sony branding is visible anywhere.

risks.risk: Seller statement that 'the brand is Sony' directly contradicts the clearly visible Canon branding and model text in all three photos, raising doubt about whether the listing text, specs, or even the item being shipped match what is pictured.
risks.proof: A fresh photo or short video of the camera powered on, showing the lens mount, body badge, and a live shot of the menu/info screen displaying the actual model, timestamped with today's date or a handwritten note.
risks.if_unproven: treat the listing as unreliable/unverified and do not price until the brand/model conflict is resolved

risks.risk: Camera's actual working condition (sensor, shutter, autofocus, LCD hinge) is unknown; only static shelf photos are shown, no power-on or shutter-fire proof.
risks.proof: Video of camera powering on, taking a test shot, and shutter count displayed on screen or via software.

risks.risk: Lens condition (fungus, scratches, haze inside) cannot be assessed from exterior-only shots.
risks.proof: Close-up photo through the lens against a bright light source showing the glass clear of fungus/haze.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens not guaranteed clear

risks.risk: Accessories (battery, charger, memory card, case) completeness is unclear; only body, lens, cap, and strap are visible.
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory bundle laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body and lens only, no extras

proof_requests: Clarify and show proof of actual brand/model to resolve the Canon vs Sony contradiction (e.g., photo of the camera powering on with its startup screen).
Video of the camera powering on and firing the shutter, ideally showing shutter count.
Close-up photo of the lens glass under light to check for fungus or scratches.
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, cable, memory card) together.
response.reason: The seller's own claim that 'the brand is Sony' flatly contradicts the clear Canon EOS 600D markings visible in every photo, which is a serious red flag about the reliability of this listing rather than a simple unproven condition claim.
